authorization.tracking: Authorization recorded at admission. Later label removal/closure tracking is not part of this increment; absence from a listing is never treated as withdrawal.

limitations: Only native blocked_by relations are read; prose, "Depends on", labels, duplicates and the inverse blocking relation are never substitutes.
Reads of issues and pages are not an atomic remote snapshot; later changes are seen by the next evaluation.
Equal counts (issue_dependencies_summary) do not certify the absence of relations GitHub does not show to this installation.

completion.reason: Publication activation: its effects are discovered by Control after cessation (own branch tip and own draft pull request); the Builder's message is not evidence.
